mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO games
platform_game_id, gname, shop_url, platform, cover_url, original_price, final_price, discount_percent, top_seller_rank, discount_rank, last_sync_time, review_count, positive_rate, review_tier,
#{game.platformGameId}, #{game.gname}, #{game.shopUrl}, #{game.platform}, #{game.coverUrl}, #{game.originalPrice}, #{game.finalPrice}, #{game.discountPercent}, #{game.topSellerRank}, #{game.discountRank}, #{game.lastSyncTime}, #{game.reviewCount}, #{game.positiveRate}, #{game.reviewTier},
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
gname = VALUES(gname), cover_url = VALUES(cover_url), shop_url = VALUES(shop_url), original_price = VALUES(original_price), final_price = VALUES(final_price), discount_percent = VALUES(discount_percent), top_seller_rank = VALUES(top_seller_rank), discount_rank = VALUES(discount_rank), review_count = VALUES(review_count), positive_rate = VALUES(positive_rate), review_tier = VALUES(review_tier),
mapper.select: SELECT id, platform, platform_game_id AS platformGameId, gname, cover_url AS coverUrl, shop_url AS shopUrl, original_price AS originalPrice, final_price AS finalPrice, discount_percent AS discountPercent, top_seller_rank AS topSellerRank, discount_rank AS discountRank, last_sync_time AS lastSyncTime, review_count AS reviewCount, positive_rate AS positiveRate, review_tier AS reviewTier FROM games WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, platform, platform_game_id AS platformGameId, gname, cover_url AS coverUrl, shop_url AS shopUrl, original_price AS originalPrice, final_price AS finalPrice, discount_percent AS discountPercent, top_seller_rank AS topSellerRank, discount_rank AS discountRank, last_sync_time AS lastSyncTime, review_count AS reviewCount, positive_rate AS positiveRate, review_tier AS reviewTier FROM games

SELECT id, platform, platform_game_id AS platformGameId, gname, cover_url AS coverUrl, shop_url AS shopUrl, original_price AS originalPrice, final_price AS finalPrice, discount_percent AS discountPercent, top_seller_rank AS topSellerRank, discount_rank AS discountRank, last_sync_time AS lastSyncTime, review_count AS reviewCount, positive_rate AS positiveRate, review_tier AS reviewTier FROM games ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT id, platform, platform_game_id AS platformGameId, gname, cover_url AS coverUrl, shop_url AS shopUrl, original_price AS originalPrice, final_price AS finalPrice, discount_percent AS discountPercent, top_seller_rank AS topSellerRank, discount_rank AS discountRank, last_sync_time AS lastSyncTime, review_count AS reviewCount, positive_rate AS positiveRate, review_tier AS reviewTier FROM games ORDER BY CASE WHEN top_seller_rank = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, top_seller_rank ASC, review_count DESC

SELECT id, platform, platform_game_id AS platformGameId, gname, cover_url AS coverUrl, shop_url AS shopUrl, original_price AS originalPrice, final_price AS finalPrice, discount_percent AS discountPercent, top_seller_rank AS topSellerRank, discount_rank AS discountRank, last_sync_time AS lastSyncTime, review_count AS reviewCount, positive_rate AS positiveRate, review_tier AS reviewTier FROM games ORDER BY CASE WHEN discount_rank = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, discount_rank ASC, review_count DESC

SELECT id, platform, platform_game_id AS platformGameId, gname, cover_url AS coverUrl, shop_url AS shopUrl, original_price AS originalPrice, final_price AS finalPrice, discount_percent AS discountPercent, top_seller_rank AS topSellerRank, discount_rank AS discountRank, last_sync_time AS lastSyncTime, review_count AS reviewCount, positive_rate AS positiveRate, review_tier AS reviewTier FROM games WHERE gname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{gname}, '%') ORDER BY CASE WHEN top_seller_rank = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, top_seller_rank ASC, review_count DESC

SELECT id, platform, platform_game_id AS platformGameId, gname, cover_url AS coverUrl, shop_url AS shopUrl, original_price AS originalPrice, final_price AS finalPrice, discount_percent AS discountPercent, top_seller_rank AS topSellerRank, discount_rank AS discountRank, last_sync_time AS lastSyncTime, review_count AS reviewCount, positive_rate AS positiveRate, review_tier AS reviewTier FROM games WHERE gname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{gname}, '%') ORDER BY CASE WHEN discount_rank = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, discount_rank ASC, review_count DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE games SET discount_rank = 0, discount_percent = 0, final_price = original_price
mapper.select: SELECT id, platform, platform_game_id AS platformGameId, gname, cover_url AS coverUrl, shop_url AS shopUrl, original_price AS originalPrice, final_price AS finalPrice, discount_percent AS discountPercent, top_seller_rank AS topSellerRank, discount_rank AS discountRank, last_sync_time AS lastSyncTime, review_count AS reviewCount, positive_rate AS positiveRate, review_tier AS reviewTier FROM games WHERE (original_price > 0 AND final_price = 0) OR (platform = 'epic' AND review_tier = '即将免费') ORDER BY last_sync_time DESC
